sources.verified_angle_summary: SparkLabs Saudi Arabia will host the SparkLabs KSU Cohort 1 Demo Day at LEAP 2026 on September 3, 2026, showcasing eight of its portfolio startups. The rapid-fire pitches will highlight ventures in deep tech, supply chain traceability, freight management, embedded finance, property operations, and sports analytics. Participating startups include Authena, Camion, MoonTech, Munjz, Vrtx, Scigeniq, Alive3D, and Optty. This specific demo day provides a focused look at Saudi Arabia's emerging tech ecosystem, backed by institutional partners like the Riyadh Valley Company, the National Technology Development Program (NTDP), and King Saud University, moving beyond the generic event scale narrative to highlight targeted investments and sector-specific innovations.
